name: Unsigned or forged message injection
note: Datasets are unsigned (ADR17); needs signed Artery/Vanetza traffic with invalid cases.

name: Constant or constant-offset position falsification
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (ConstPos, ConstPosOffset); D01 'spoofing'; D03 attack list to verify.

name: Random position falsification
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (RandomPos, RandomPosOffset).

name: Speed, acceleration or heading falsification
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (ConstSpeed, ConstSpeedOffset, RandomSpeed, RandomSpeedOffset); heading-only falsification to check.

name: Eventual stop
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (EventualStop).

name: Physically consistent false trajectory
note: Adaptive attacker that keeps position, speed and timing mutually consistent to evade residual checks (audit A07). P6 robustness only.

name: Data replay
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (DataReplay). Replayed signed messages can still verify; freshness checks matter.

name: Delayed messages
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (DelayedMessages). Needs trusted receiver time (audit A03).

name: Disruptive replay of other vehicles' data
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (Disruptive).

name: Flooding / denial of service from one identity
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (DoS, DoSRandom, DoSDisruptive); D01 'flooding'. Offline-injected DoS does not show channel effects (source S08).

name: Sybil ghost vehicles (fake traffic)
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (GridSybil); D01 'sybil'.

name: Sybil combined with replay or DoS
note: VeReMi Extension attack names per its documentation; confirm in data card (4A.1) (DataReplaySybil, DoSRandomSybil, DoSDisruptiveSybil).

name: Pseudonym abuse to evade history or pose as several vehicles
note: Rapid or parallel pseudonym use; must be separated from legitimate rotation (BN04).

name: Compromised RSU: false reports, altered or suppressed logs
note: Detected by multi-receiver cross-checks and evidence signing/consensus (P7, experiment E09).

name: Radio jamming
note: Reported as degraded reception, not attributed to a sender. D05 gives real benign impairment for contrast; jamming itself simulated.

name: GNSS spoofing of honest senders
note: Sender is honest but its GNSS is spoofed: looks like falsification. Incident must not blame the sender's credentials.

name: GNSS spoofing or loss at the receiver (OBU ego data)
note: D04 gives real benign GNSS/IMU/speed for consistency baselines; spoofing simulated. Corrupts ADR16 ego cross-checks if undetected.

name: Tampering with the receiver's speed or inertial sensors
note: No data source identified yet; candidate for own-vehicle bench recording (P4B) with injected faults.

name: Hard braking and emergency manoeuvres
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: Tunnels, urban canyons, GNSS outage or multipath
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: High density and channel congestion
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: Legitimate pseudonym rotation
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: GNSS noise near decision thresholds
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: Stopped vehicles sending unchanged data
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: Vehicles joining late or leaving range
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.

name: Close following and adjacent lanes (nearby honest identities)
note: Not an attack. Used to measure false alarms on situations that resemble attacks.
